# Example: if Statement

#### Course: Learn Java Basics

## Example: if Statement

Let's use the if statement to check if a student has passed or failed the exam. For this, we'll assume the passing grade is 50 or above.

```java
1import java.util.Scanner;
2
3class Main {
4
5    public static void main(String[] args) {
6
7        Scanner input = new Scanner(System.in);
8        // Get student score from the user
9        System.out.println("Enter grade");
10        int studentGrade = input.nextInt();
11
12        // If studentGrade is 50 or above, studentGrade >= 50 results to true
13        if (studentGrade >= 50) {
14            System.out.println("Congratulations!");
15            System.out.println("You passed the examination.");
16        }
17    }
18}
```

Sample Output 1

```text
Enter grade
90
Congratulations!
You passed the examination.
```

If the user enters 90, studentGrade >= 50 in the if statement will be true. In this case, the statements inside the if statements are executed.

Sample Output 2

```text
Enter grade
35
```

If the user enters 35, studentGrade >= 50 in the if statement will be false. In this case, the statements inside the if statements are skipped from execution.
